== Build notes ==
Insert was a polybag extra with InQuest Gamer #49 (May 1999), not a bound interior article. Internet Archive bound scan of that issue has no R'kik leaf. Dest: Encyclopedia 3.2 p.186 sealed-bag cover (FREE STAR WARS EXCLUSIVE CARD banner), IA leaf 0 cover, IA leaf 1 contents (The Emperor's Hand SWCCG top-10 is a separate article, not dested here). Encyclopedia also lists a 16-page SWCCG price guide in the same bag. follow-up dest 24 October 2026.
